_comment: CW single-track 316L calibration. Fit one shared elec_resistivity + LeeCoeff pair across three Hofmann validation cases. All other SS316L thermophysical values are fixed from the Hofmann validation template.

objective._comment: Per-case error = mean(|depth_err|, |width_err|, |ar_err|). AR = meltPoolDepth / meltPoolWidth. The aspect-ratio term penalizes compensating errors (e.g. depth+10% & width−10% fools plain mean-abs). Candidate objective = mean over all cases. Lower is better.

optimizer._comment: Bayesian optimization (Optuna TPE). nSamples = total candidate budget (224 parameter sets). Each candidate can run every validation case, so the solver-run budget is nSamples × number of cases. First initSamples (32) are a Latin-Hypercube design for exploration; after that the TPE surrogate proposes where melt-pool error is likely lower. Proposals stream in batches up to maxParallel (constant-liar keeps a batch diversified). Lower objective is better.

parameters._comment: Only elec_resistivity and LeeCoeff are active. Everything else is fixed to the Hofmann validation SS316L baseline. Marangoni_Constant = sigma × dSigmadT_norm.

cp_solid_scale._note: Fixed at baseline. Multiplicative on solid cp table (T ≤ Tsolidus=1658K).

kappa_solid_scale._note: Fixed at baseline. Multiplicative on solid kappa table (T ≤ Tsolidus).

rho._note: Fixed to SS316 liquid density from table (T >= 1723K). Model uses one metal rho scalar, so liquid value is used for melt-pool flow.

nu._note: Fixed from table dynamic viscosity: nu = mu/rho_liq = 8e-3 Pa.s / 6881 kg/m3.

geometry._comment: Common geometry constants in metres. Per-case y/z extents computed from these + process/target.

cases.name: case_P200_v1200
cases._exp_rows: Hofmann row 161: P=200W v=1200mm/s d=0.05mm bare plate. Lower energy density → conduction-dominated, improves identifiability.

earlyAbort._comment: Abort a running case only once the melt pool has stabilized and the error is still above threshold. Remaining cases are still run so the shared two-knob fit sees all three operating points.

cleanup._comment: Disk saver: keep ONLY the best valid candidate's full data (VTK + processor*/). A candidate is best-valid only when every calibration case reaches status=done; low_dt/failed/skipped/aborted candidates still train the optimizer but are stripped. The tiny post-processing CSV, logs and case_build.json are always kept, so scoring is unaffected.

longTrackValidation._comment: After calibration only: if the best candidate objective is <=5% and its calibration logs have healthy timestep statistics (mean deltaT >=1e-7 OR at least 80% of deltaT values >=1e-7 for every case), run a 1.5 mm long-track validation for each calibration case using the same post-processing.

execution._comment: maxParallel = floor(totalCores / coresPerSim) = 8 parallel sims. Override with env CALIB_TOTAL_CORES / CALIB_CORES_PER_SIM (HPC sets these via job_calibration.sh). With 3 cases per candidate, 8 parallel sims keeps the swarm full as cases finish.
execution._watchdog: Progress-based, not wall-clock. Kill a sim if no solver output appears for perSimStartupSec, solver Time stops advancing for perSimStallSec, or deltaT stays below minDeltaTAbort for minDeltaTConsecutivePolls poll intervals. LOW_DT cases get lowDeltaTPenalty instead of the hard failure penalty. Set minDeltaTAbort <= 0 to disable the low-deltaT abort.
